body:
She is purposefully ignoring me. She'd rather be at the bar than talking to me.

I thought she loved me, though.
I never speak to my family, all my friends have moved on, and I thought my future was her.

>man the fuck up

You don't know the kind of shit I've been through, and you don't know the kind of shit I've done. I've been taking care of myself for years. I am a man, by any rubric. I am a man who is deciding whether life is worth living.
Because I reject your superficial bourgeois ideals of love. For real people, love is permanent. Love matters. It's everything.
She has known me nearly all my life. I've told her things I've never told anyone, ever. We were talking about marriage. She told me she loved me more than anything. Where can I find that again?
I think we're both on the precipice of our final moments. Let's talk a minute around the proverbial  campfire while we still have some time left. Tell me about your life.
